summary: Conditional adjacent-byte-pair swap over the buffer a2. When the enable byte at this+0x9 equals 16 and the product of the dword count at this+0x0 and the stride byte at this+0xA is non-zero, swaps each adjacent byte pair of a2, iterating count*stride times and advancing the buffer pointer by two bytes per iteration.

operations.description: Proceed only when the byte at this+0x9 equals 16 (enable flag).
Compute the iteration count as the dword at this+0x0 times the byte at this+0xA; the swap runs only while that product is non-zero.
For each iteration, swap the adjacent byte pair at a2[0] and a2[1], then advance the buffer pointer by two bytes; repeat count*stride times.
